summary: Repo-root gitignore. Line 9 was a bare `docs/` pattern intended only for the repo-root internal-docs folder, but an unanchored gitignore pattern matches a directory of that name ANYWHERE in the tree — it was silently excluding `site-astro/src/pages/docs/` from git too, so 3 new page files created there this session never showed up in `git status` and would have been dropped from the PR entirely. Fixed by anchoring it to `/docs/`.
incidentAliases: new files missing from git status
